true_answer: The following table shows how many students failed in each single subject and in their various combina- tions: Subject: A B C AB AC BC ABC Failed: 12 5 8 2 6 3 1 How many students failed at least one subject? Solution . The answer is not 37, even though the sum of the num- bers above is 37. For example, while 12 students failed Algebra, 2 of those students also failed Biology, 6 also failed Chemestry, and 1 of those failed all three subjects. In fact, that 1 student who failed all three subjects is counted a total of 7 times in the total 37.
